text: Hunter × Hunter is a Japanese manga series created by Yoshihiro Togashi. It began serialization in Weekly Shonen Jump in 1998 and has been released irregularly because of the author's health, but it has over thirty collected volumes.

The story follows a boy named Gon Freecss who grows up on Whale Island. He discovers that his father, Ging, is actually alive and is a famous Hunter, a licensed elite who takes on dangerous jobs around the world.

After learning the truth about his father, Gon decides to become a Hunter himself. He leaves his home island, determined to pass the Hunter Exam and eventually meet Ging to prove that he can follow the same path.

Hunters in this world are licensed professionals who can explore unknown places, track rare creatures, search for treasures, or chase criminals. The Hunter License gives them many privileges, such as access to restricted areas and valuable information.

During the Hunter Exam, Gon befriends three main companions: Killua Zoldyck, Kurapika, and Leorio. Each of them has their own goals, such as escaping an assassin family, avenging a fallen clan, or becoming a doctor.

Killua is the heir of the famous Zoldyck family of assassins. Although he was trained to kill from childhood, he rebels against this life and chooses Gon as his best friend, joining him on many adventures.

Kurapika is the last surviving member of the Kurta Clan, whose people were massacred for their scarlet eyes. He becomes a Hunter to track down the Phantom Troupe, the criminal group responsible for the tragedy.

Leorio at first seems interested only in money, but his true goal is to study medicine and become a doctor who can treat people for free. He hopes the Hunter License will help him pay for his education and gain influence.

One of the core power systems in Hunter × Hunter is called Nen. Nen users learn to control and shape their life energy, called aura, allowing them to strengthen their bodies, enhance senses, or create unique abilities.

Nen abilities are grouped into several categories, such as Enhancement, Emission, Manipulation, Conjuration, Transmutation, and Specialization. A user's personality often influences which category they are strongest in.

The series is divided into several major story arcs, including the Hunter Exam, Heavens Arena, Yorknew City, Greed Island, Chimera Ant, and the Election arc, followed by the ongoing Dark Continent-related storyline.
Hunter × Hunter has received two main anime adaptations. The first was produced by Nippon Animation from 1999 to 2001 and was followed by several original video animations that continued the story.
A second anime series produced by Madhouse aired from 2011 to 2014. This version retold the story from the beginning and adapted the manga up through the Election arc, totaling 148 episodes.

The franchise has expanded beyond manga and anime into movies, video games, stage plays, and musicals. Two animated films were released in 2013, adding original stories set in the Hunter × Hunter universe.

Hunter × Hunter is widely praised for its strategic battles, complex power system, and morally gray characters. The Chimera Ant arc in particular is often cited as one of the strongest story arcs in modern shonen anime.

The manga has sold tens of millions of copies worldwide and is considered one of Shueisha's best-selling series. It frequently ranks high in popularity polls and appears on lists of the greatest manga and anime of all time.
Despite the many hiatuses, fans remain very loyal to the series. Each time new chapters are announced, there is a surge of excitement online, and new printings of the volumes often see strong sales.

The world of Hunter × Hunter includes many unique locations, such as Whale Island, Heaven's Arena, Yorknew City, Greed Island, and the Chimera Ant kingdom in the NGL. Each setting has its own rules and atmosphere.

Themes explored in Hunter × Hunter include friendship, ambition, moral ambiguity, and the cost of power. Characters often face difficult ethical choices, and even villains are given complex motivations.
Gon himself is not a typical perfect hero; his determination sometimes turns into obsession, leading to dark consequences. This makes his character arc one of the most memorable aspects of the story.
